reasons.text: About 57% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with excess rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 11 bu/ac lower.
In years with a wet spring (planting delays), corn yields here tend to be about 4 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is spring wetness: from about -5 bu/ac in 2019 to about +4 bu/ac in 2013.
